slug.description: Active game slug. Injected by the workbench host; required.

assetPath.description: Game-relative path of a RIGGED asset (must already have a rigged_model FBX from gen3d:auto-rig). The animated GLB+FBX for this motion are appended to THIS asset.

motionType.description: Hunyuan motion_retarget v1 fixed motion: 9 跨步 / 10 摔倒 / 11 跳跃 / 12 踢腿 / 13 挥击 / 14 步行 / 15 跑步 / 16 跳舞. Idempotent per motion: re-applying an existing motionType returns the existing manifest.
